company.codeHelp: Identifies the company across the installation. It cannot be changed after creation.
company.countryPattern: Use the two-letter ISO code, for example PE.
company.defaultCountryHelp: Applied to imported locations that leave the country blank. It never changes an existing location.
company.description: Company details, time zone and document numbering.
company.newCompanyNote: The new company appears in your company selector, because your role reaches the whole organization.
company.numberingHelp: The prefix belongs to this company; the digits come from one installation-wide counter, so changing it renumbers nothing and cannot create a duplicate.
company.prefixPattern: One to six letters or digits followed by a hyphen, for example TO-.
company.timeZoneHelp: Decides what "today" means for this company. Use an IANA id, for example America/Lima.
company.title: Company

clients.description: Machine credentials partner systems authenticate with. Each one belongs to this company and cannot be pointed at another.

empty.message: Issue one so a partner system can send us locations, orders or positions.
empty.title: No credentials yet

form.carrierHelp: Which carrier's tenders this key answers. Required for the tender scope and refused for any other, because a key that may answer offers must say whose.
form.carrierRequired: Choose the carrier this credential answers for.
form.createSubtitle: The secret is generated now and shown once.
form.editSubtitle: Renaming and re-scoping. The secret is not affected.
form.nameHelp: How this key is identified in the list and in the audit trail, for example "Store WMS".
form.scopeRequired: Choose at least one scope. A credential that may do nothing still authenticates.

clients.revokeText: Both the current and any superseded secret stop working at once, and this cannot be undone. The credential's history is kept.
clients.rotateText: A new secret is issued now. The old one keeps working for the configured grace window so the partner can redeploy. Revoke instead if it may have leaked.
clients.title: Credentials

deliveries.description: What we pushed out, and what came back. Every attempt is kept.

detail.eventIdHelp: Stable across every attempt and redelivery. Your system deduplicates on this.
detail.noResponse: No response: the call never reached a server.
detail.payloadHelp: The exact bytes every attempt sent, frozen when the delivery was queued so a retry is identical to the first try.
detail.title: Delivery

empty.message: Deliveries appear here as soon as a subscribed event happens.
empty.title: Nothing delivered yet

deliveries.title: Delivery log

integrations.description: What is connected to this company: who may write into us, and where our events go.

inbox.description: Every delivery a partner sent us, whatever the outcome. No payload content is kept here.

empty.message: Nothing has been sent to this company yet.
empty.title: Inbox empty

inbox.title: Inbound activity

noAccess.message: You need integration credential or webhook permissions to see this screen.
noAccess.title: Not available to your role

locationWrite.help: Create and update stores and locations. Cannot read anything back.
locationWrite.label: Write locations

orderWrite.help: Create and update transport orders unattended. The most powerful scope: grant it only to a system you would let place orders without a person looking.
orderWrite.label: Write orders

shipmentRead.help: Read confirmed shipments and poll the change feed. Read-only: it grants no write anywhere.
shipmentRead.label: Read shipments

tenderRespond.help: See and answer the tenders offered to one carrier. Needs a carrier, and shows that carrier's offers only.
tenderRespond.label: Answer tenders

trackingWrite.help: Report vehicle positions. Write-only: a telematics feed learns nothing about the shipments it pushes against.
trackingWrite.label: Report positions

secret.subtitle: Shown once. It cannot be recovered afterwards.

integrations.title: Integration Hub

webhooks.description: Endpoints we push this company's events to, signed and retried. Polling the change feed keeps working either way.

empty.message: Add one so a partner system is told as soon as something happens, instead of polling for it.
empty.title: No endpoints yet

form.createSubtitle: The signing secret is generated now and shown once.
form.editSubtitle: Renaming, re-pointing and re-selecting events. The secret and the paused state are not affected.
form.eventRequired: Choose at least one event. An endpoint that selects nothing receives nothing.
form.eventsHelp: The same vocabulary as the change feed. New types appear here automatically.
form.nameHelp: How this endpoint is identified in the list and in the delivery log, for example "ERP orders".
form.targetUrlHelp: Must be https and publicly reachable. Internal and loopback addresses are refused.

webhooks.pauseText: Deliveries stop being sent. Nothing is discarded: events keep queueing and are released when you resume.
webhooks.resumeText: Queued deliveries are released and the failure count is cleared.
webhooks.rotateText: The new secret takes effect immediately and without a grace window, so accept both on your side while you redeploy. Deliveries signed with the old secret will fail verification from now on.
webhooks.title: Webhook endpoints

users.description: Who can work in this company, and with which roles.
users.emailHelp: If the address already exists in the installation, that account is reused and only given access to this company.
users.emailImmutable: The address identifies the account and is not editable. To change it, revoke access and invite the new address.

empty.message: Invite somebody so they can work in this company.
empty.title: Nobody here yet

form.editSubtitle: This person's name and roles in this company.
form.inviteSubtitle: They will get access to this company with the roles you choose.

users.restoreText: They will work in this company again with the roles they already had.
users.revokeText: They will stop working in this company. Their account and their history are untouched.
users.selfRolesLocked: You cannot change your own roles. Ask another administrator of this company to do it.
users.title: Users and access
